model_meta.description: Concept model of a valve using a rotatable closure member and specially shaped mating sealing surfaces.

subsystems.description: Valve structure defining a flow channel between first and second openings and walls supporting the first sealing surface.

Closure member within the flow channel, with a sealing section and second sealing surface; rotates about an offset rotation axis between open and closed positions. At least one sealing surface has non-conical asymmetric geometry; the patent describes offset-apex cross sections and section-defined variants.
Shaft transmits force to rotate the closure member about its rotation axis in the described embodiment.

Separate seal subsystem representing the wall-extending seal that provides the first sealing surface in the illustrated embodiment; it is not a universal arrangement, since another embodiment locates the seal at the closure-member sealing surface.
Passage extending between the valve's first and second openings; represented to show the internal fluid route, not as an external endpoint.

item_flows.name: Fluid through channel
item_flows.notes: Flow between the first and second openings is prevented in the closed position; no specific fluid or preferred direction is specified.

item_flows.name: Sealing-surface contact
item_flows.notes: Contact between first and second sealing surfaces in the closed position.

requirements.statement: In the closed position, the first and second sealing surfaces contact to prevent flow between the first and second openings.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; described operation states flow in either direction is prevented.

requirements.statement: At least one sealing surface has the claimed non-conical shape asymmetric in at least one area, definable by vertical cross sections of cones with mutually offset apexes.
requirements.rationale: Claims 1–2; geometric design values are not specified here.

requirements.statement: The closure member is rotatable about an axis between open and closed positions; the axis has the recited offset relationship to the sealing section and closure-member centerline.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; claim 5 permits the second predetermined distance to be zero.

requirements.statement: At least one sealing surface is definable by at least three sections arranged parallel to the rotation axis at predetermined distances in the closure member thickness direction; their center points are offset from one another along the closure member major-axis direction.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; represent the claimed qualitative section arrangement without assigning dimensions or converting it to executable constraints.

requirements.statement: At least one of the first and second sealing surfaces has a rounded shape at least at one location.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; does not infer which surface or additional rounded locations.

steps.description: Rotate the closure member about its rotation axis between the open and closed positions; in the closed position the sealing surfaces contact.
